name: Apache Solr Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source full-text, vector and geospatial search server with HTTP APIs, indexing, facets, replication and distributed SolrCloud; no vendor-imposed software index or query quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires JVM resources, storage, network security, patching, backups and operational expertise; optional cloud infrastructure, managed services and third-party integrations cost extra.
